architecture_summary: Modular React SPA. Pages in src/pages/. Shared UI in src/components/. Routes via React Router. State: React Context + local component state. Styling: CSS Modules. Build: Vite. Data: mock API layer (src/mocks/) until backend ready. Ponytail: no Redux (overkill for SPA), no Next.js (no SSR needed).

tickets.title: Splash screen page component (src/pages/Splash.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch splash screen to React. Static layout. Centered brand logo + name. Full viewport height. Auto-redirect to /dashboard after 2s. Ponytail: no animation lib (CSS @keyframes).

tickets.title: Dashboard home page component (src/pages/Dashboard.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch dashboard. Top nav bar (shared component). Stats cards grid. Recent activity list. Ponytail: no chart lib (static SVG for now).

tickets.title: Registration page component (src/pages/Register.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch registration form. Form fields: name, email, password, confirm password. Client-side validation. Submit button. Ponytail: no form lib (native HTML5 validation).

tickets.title: Product catalog & event pages (src/pages/EventCatalog.jsx, src/pages/EventDetail.jsx, src/pages/ProductDetail.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch product/event screens. EventCatalog: grid of event cards. EventDetail: event info + CTA. ProductDetail: product info + add to cart. Ponytail: no state management (local state for cart count).
acceptance_criteria: Add to cart updates local state

tickets.title: Order & invoice pages (src/pages/MyOrders.jsx, src/pages/OrderReview.jsx, src/pages/InvoiceManager.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch order/invoice screens. MyOrders: list of user orders. OrderReview: order summary + recipient options. InvoiceManager: invoice validation UI. Ponytail: no PDF lib (static invoice preview).
acceptance_criteria: Recipient option selection persists in local state

tickets.title: Homework & exam schedule pages (src/pages/HomeworkSearch.jsx, src/pages/ExamCalendar.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch homework/exam screens. HomeworkSearch: search bar + results list. ExamCalendar: calendar view with exam dates. Ponytail: no calendar lib (static grid for now).

tickets.title: Jasa Titip home page (src/pages/JasaTitipHome.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch Jasa Titip home. Hero banner. Service categories grid. Featured items carousel. Ponytail: no carousel lib (CSS scroll-snap).

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Set up React Router. Routes: / (splash), /dashboard, /register, /events, /event/:id, /product/:id, /orders, /order/:id, /invoice/:id, /homework, /exams, /jasatitip. NavBar: shared component with active route highlighting. Ponytail: no lazy loading (small app).
acceptance_criteria: All routes render correct page components
NavBar active state matches current route
